heading: Overview
content: This document describes the configuration options for the application server. Each section covers a different subsystem.

heading: Database Configuration
content: The database subsystem supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite backends. Connection pooling is enabled by default with a pool size of 10. Set DB_URL environment variable to configure the connection string.

heading: Cache Layer
content: Redis and Memcached are supported as cache backends. Redis is recommended for most deployments due to persistence support. Configure via CACHE_URL environment variable. TTL defaults to 3600 seconds.

heading: Authentication
content: Supports OAuth2, SAML, and API key authentication. Multiple providers can be configured simultaneously. JWT tokens expire after 24 hours by default. See the security hardening guide for production recommendations.

heading: Logging
content: Structured JSON logging is the default output format. Log levels: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL. Configure via LOG_LEVEL and LOG_FORMAT environment variables. Supports stdout, file, and syslog outputs.
